premises.text: Moving money in Africa is slow and costly because 155-plus isolated mobile money wallets hinder cross-network, cross-border, and online payments
premises.evidence_span: There are more than 155 mobile money wallets running, isolated one from another in our continent, making it very difficult to make cross-network payments, cross-border payments, and online payments

premises.text: A universal payment platform lets online merchants accept cash and mobile money wallets through a single API with high conversion, blockchain-ledger security, and multi-currency ease for the unbanked
premises.evidence_span: WeCashUp is a universal mobile money payment platform that enables online merchants to accept all cash and mobile money wallet online through a single API

premises.text: Version 2.0 also supports cards, bank mobile wallets, and cryptocurrencies plus merchant features such as split, disburse, marketplace hold, and airtime top-up across many African countries
premises.evidence_span: supports cash, mobile money, credit and debit card, bank mobile wallet, and cryptocurrencies

premises.text: A patented blockchain tunneling interoperability network interconnects payment channels for secured cross-network, cross-border, and online payments
premises.evidence_span: we have built the first blockchain tunneling network which is a global interoperability network that secures and interconnects all these payment channels

premises.text: Revenue comes from a monthly fee plus a transaction fee
premises.evidence_span: We charge a monthly fee and a transaction fee

value.text: Merchants and people in Africa can move and accept money fast enough for critical needs across wallets and borders
value.evidence_span: Moving money fast here in Africa is very, very difficult

causal_links.evidence_span: It can be a matter of life or death
ease of transaction processing for the unbanked across currencies
facilitate cross-network payments, cross-border payments, and online payments globally
We charge a monthly fee and a transaction fee

notes: Wallet isolation pain folded as one problem set. Single-API acceptance and v2 channel/feature expansion kept as one merchant platform mechanism with cascade of rails/features; blockchain tunneling kept separate as distinct interoperability module with patents folded as IP detail. Merchant traction excluded. Personal hospital story used only as value framing evidence.
